'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Casey Anis LS Yavin 4 Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
